name.title: Name
name.description: Username of the current session's user.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Permissions granted by the union of the user's roles. The frontend gates navigation and controls on these; the backend enforces them independently (AUTH.AUTHpermissions).

must_change_password.title: Must Change Password
must_change_password.description: Whether the user must change their password before continuing to use the app.

400.description: New password must be at least 8 characters, or must differ from the current password

401.description: Not logged in, or the current password provided is incorrect
